description: FaultScope demo topology. An entry {service: A, depends_on: B} is the graph edge A -> B: A depends on B, so if B fails, A may be affected.

services.name: api-gateway
services.description: Entry point for all client traffic

dependencies.rationale: Every protected route verifies its token with Auth; login is proxied to Auth.
Order routes are proxied; login and gateway health keep working without Order.
An order cannot be priced or reserved without Inventory (Phase 1 returns 502).
An order cannot be charged without Payment (Phase 1 returns 502 and releases stock).
Best-effort: the order still succeeds with notification 'degraded' (Phase 1 e2e test).
